description: This file defines the `VoiceWakePreferences` enum that contains static methods and constants for managing voice wake trigger words, including loading, saving, sanitizing, and decoding trigger words from JSON payloads.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: A nested struct conforming to Decodable used internally to decode JSON payloads containing trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: String)
methods.description: Decodes JSON string payload to extract trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: Data)
methods.description: Decodes Data payload to extract trigger words using JSONDecoder.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords(defaults: UserDefaults)
methods.description: Loads trigger words from UserDefaults, defaulting to predefined defaults.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords(_: [String])
methods.description: Sanitizes the list of trigger words by trimming, filtering empty strings, limiting count and length.

methods.name: displayString(for: [String])
methods.description: Returns a display string of the sanitized trigger words joined by commas.
